visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a medium shot of a man in a blue and white varsity jacket leaning against a white luxury convertible Mercedes-Benz parked in a mountainous area with a wooden marker in the background. (2) A rapid montage follows, showing a silhouette of the man in front of a giant red torii gate by a lake, a coastal beach under a cloudy sky, and a traditional Japanese bridge over a canal. (3) The man is seen holding a smartphone displaying weather charts for Mt. Fuji visibility, followed by a wide shot of a highway with green directional signs and a view of a Lawson convenience store under a dark sky. (4) The man stands in front of a Seven-Eleven convenience store next to the white Mercedes, gesturing towards the building. (5) Close-up shots of a bowl of thick noodles being lifted with chopsticks, then the man eating heartily inside a restaurant. (6) Scenes shift to Oishi Park with lavender-like bushes, views of Mt. Fuji partially obscured by clouds, and a souvenir shop interior where the man holds a Mt. Fuji-themed cup. (7) Interior hotel scenes show a large window overlooking a forest, a bookshelf-filled lounge, and the man walking through the room. (8) Outdoor scenes at Mt. Omuro feature a chairlift ride, a green volcanic crater rim, and a capybara being fed at a zoo. (9) The man stands on a rocky volcanic coast looking at the sea, followed by a night scene of him in a hot spring pool. (10) Driving scenes show the man in the convertible by the coast, buying a small bottle of pudding, and visiting the MOA Museum of Art with large scrolls. (11) Final sequences show the man at Hakone Shrine's lakeside torii gate, a dense forest path with many tourists, and a night drive with the Tokyo Tower illuminated in the background.

(2) A sharp 'whoosh' transition SFX marks the change between the intro and the travel montage. The background environmental floor features slight wind and coastal wave ambience under the dominant music. (3) Slurping and chewing sounds are clearly audible during the restaurant phase, synchronized with the visual eating action. (4) Mechanical sounds of a vehicle engine and tires on pavement rise slightly during the driving segments. (5) Another series of rapid 'pop' and 'click' digital sound effects accompany the display of the smartphone screen and watch. (6) The vocal tone remains consistently friendly and enthusiastic, with moderate melodic intonation. (7) Toward the end, the acoustic texture shifts to include forest birds and a soft crowd murmur during the shrine segment, followed by the hum of a car interior at night.
